Authors: Andrey V. Pichugov, Oussama Fayafrou, David Gajan, Laurent Veyre, Chloé Thieuleux, Clément Camp

While the synthesis of a molecular tungsten–iridium complex remains elusive, the silica-supported tungsten species, (SiO)W(C t Bu)(CH 2 t Bu) 2 , reacts with Cp*IrH 4 , leading to heterobimetallic surface sites highly active in arene H/D exchange.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc06151f

item.title: Modular construction of amines and indazoles via an internal oxidizing N–O bond-enabled redox-neutral regioselective C–H amination and N–N formation cascade
item.description:
Authors: Jun Zhang, Xiaojian Chen, Yinuo Huang, Hulin Zhong, Yuan Liu, Yang Gao, Qian Chen, Yanping Huo, Xianwei Li

By pairing traceless directing groups with N–OPiv oxidizing amination reagents, facilitating a regioselective C–H amination and N–N bond formation cascade, indazole products are furnished in a redox-neutral manner.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc05559a

item.title: Ru( ii )-catalyzed site-selective C5 acylmethylation/annulation of 2-arylquinolin-4(1 H )-ones with sulfoxonium ylides via weak coordination
item.description:
Authors: Ajay Kant Gola, Satyendra Kumar Pandey

A novel Ru( ii )-catalyzed, oxo-directed C5–H acylmethylation of 2-arylquinolin-4(1 H )-ones with sulfoxonium ylides, followed by Tf 2 O-mediated cyclization, has been developed for the semi-one-pot synthesis of fused pyrano[2,3,4- de ]quinolones.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc06067f

item.title: Site-specific thiopyrophosphorylation and functionalization of phosphate residues in oligonucleotides and peptides
item.description:
Authors: Song Yang, Bing He, Shuai Wang, Qianqian Wu, Wenlong Guo, Fengling Song, Pengcheng Wang, Debin Ji

Diamidothiophosphate (DATP) acts as a phosphorylating agent to install a highly reactive, bioorthogonal thiophosphate handle for diverse downstream functionalization.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc03896d

item.title: Metal–organic frameworks for photocatalytic CO 2 reduction: recent advances, design principles, and mechanistic insights
item.description:
Authors: Hai-Xiong Liu, Ying-Xuan He, Zhen-Zeng Wu, Zheng-Han Cai, Rui-Xu Cai, Jun Zhang, Xiao-Ya Wang, Chen-Yang Yao, Sheng-Yun Zhao, Liang-Liang Zhang

To overcome the limitations of MOFs in photocatalytic CO 2 reduction, this review summarizes recent advances in framework engineering and elucidates the underlying photophysical mechanisms.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc03786k

item.title: Boosting electrocatalytic nitrate reduction to ammonia through B-site Ni tuning of a triple-conducting perovskite
item.description:
Authors: Sanzhao Song, Mujia Sun, Obeylaw Moyo, Zhenbao Zhang, Yujie Tong, Xinzhi Yu, Xi Wu, Yuxin Lian, Jiaqiao Yang, Junxiong Zhang, Jie Dai, Hainan Sun

A triple-conducting Ba(Fe 0.4 Co 0.4 Zr 0.1 Y 0.1 ) 0.95 Ni 0.05 O 3− δ perovskite with B-site Ni doping boosts local proton supply to active centers, delivering 98.7% faradaic efficiency and a high NH 3 yield for electrochemical nitrate reduction.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc05049b
